citationAudit.method: Static source audit. Strip unescaped TeX percent comments and comment environments; recursively resolve uncommented input/include; collect cite-family commands and nocite; inspect bibliography directives. This is not a TeX compilation.
assumptions: No conditional citation/include directives or custom citation macros are present in the audited sources.

The target git tree contains no supplementary source or supporting-information files beyond template placeholders. A textual promise of Table S1 does not include those publications in the compiled bibliography.
